title: quercus robur var. fastigiata
intro: Quercus robur var. fastigiata, commonly known as the Fastigiate English Oak, is a variant of the Quercus robur tree with a narrow, columnar growth habit. This tree is valued for its health benefits, which include reducing inflammation and improving cardiovascular health due to its high content of polyphenols and flavonoids. The therapeutic actions of Quercus robur var. fastigiata include antioxidant, anti-inflammatory, and antimicrobial activities, making it a potential treatment for various conditions such as arthritis and infections. The bioactive constituents of this plant include quercetin, a flavonoid with potent antioxidant properties, and other polyphenolic compounds that contribute to its therapeutic effects.
